terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern the use of Sojori's platform and services. By accessing or using our services, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms.

sections.title: 1. Service Scope
sections.content: Sojori provides property management and orchestration software for hospitality operators. The platform enables users to manage properties, reservations, guest communication, staff coordination, dynamic pricing and owner reporting through a centralised interface. Sojori acts as a technology provider and is not a party to any rental agreement between hosts and guests.

sections.title: 2. Account & Access
sections.content: You must provide accurate and complete information when registering. Your account is personal, non-transferable and may not be shared. You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. You agree to notify Sojori immediately of any unauthorised use.

sections.title: 3. Subscription, Fees & Payment
sections.content: Subscription fees are billed monthly or annually according to the plan selected. All prices are listed exclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. Payments are due in advance. In the event of non-payment, Sojori reserves the right to suspend or terminate access to the platform after reasonable notice. Refunds are not provided except as required by applicable law or as specified in your plan's trial terms.

sections.title: 4. Free Trial
sections.content: New accounts may benefit from a free trial period of one (1) month. During the trial no payment information is required. At the end of the trial the account will be suspended unless a paid plan is activated. No data is deleted during suspension; you may reactivate at any time.

sections.title: 5. User Responsibilities
sections.content: Users must use the platform in compliance with all applicable laws, including local hospitality regulations. Users are responsible for the accuracy of property listings, descriptions, pricing and availability. Sojori is not responsible for double bookings, pricing errors, regulatory fines, or disputes arising from inaccurate user-provided data.

sections.title: 6. Data Protection & Privacy
sections.content: Sojori collects and processes personal data solely for the purpose of providing, improving and securing the service. We do not sell personal data to third parties. Guest data processed through the platform (passport scans, contact details) is handled in accordance with GDPR and Moroccan data-protection law (Loi 09-08). Full details are provided in our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 7. Integrations & Third-Party Services
sections.content: The platform integrates with third-party services including but not limited to WhatsApp Business API, Channex, Rentals United and payment gateways. Sojori is not responsible for the availability, accuracy or policies of these third-party services. Your use of integrated services is subject to their own terms.

sections.title: 8. Service Availability
sections.content: Sojori aims to maintain high availability but does not guarantee uninterrupted access. Planned maintenance windows will be communicated in advance when possible. Sojori shall not be liable for outages caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including internet disruptions, third-party API failures, or force majeure events.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: The platform is provided "as is" and "as available". To the fullest extent permitted by law, Sojori's total liability for any claim arising from or related to the service shall not exceed the fees paid by the user in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. Sojori shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential or punitive damages.

sections.title: 10. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All software, content, trademarks, logos and documentation remain the exclusive property of Sojori SAS. Users may not copy, decompile, reverse-engineer, modify, redistribute or create derivative works from any part of the platform without prior written consent.

sections.title: 11. Termination
sections.content: Users may cancel their subscription at any time from the dashboard or by contacting support. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Sojori may terminate or suspend accounts for material breach of these Terms, non-payment, or illegal activity, with or without prior notice depending on severity.

sections.title: 12. Governing Law & Disputes
sections.content: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco. Any dispute shall first be submitted to good-faith mediation. If mediation fails, the competent courts of Casablanca shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

sections.title: 13. Changes to These Terms
sections.content: Sojori may update these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be notified via email or in-app notification at least thirty (30) days before they take effect. Continued use of the platform after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

privacy.intro: At Sojori, your privacy is our priority. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it and the rights you have over it.

sections.title: 1. Data We Collect
sections.content:
We collect the minimum data necessary to provide and improve the service:

• Contact details (name, email, phone) provided during sign-up or demo requests.
• Business information (company name, number of properties, role) shared when engaging with our services.
• Guest data (names, passport scans, contact details) processed on behalf of our users for check-in and identity verification.
• Technical data (IP address, browser type, device, access logs) collected automatically for security and performance.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
sections.content:
Your data is used to:

• Provide and operate the Sojori platform.
• Process demo requests and appointment scheduling.
• Send transactional notifications (booking confirmations, task alerts).
• Improve service quality, fix bugs and develop new features.
• Ensure platform security and prevent fraud.
• Comply with legal and regulatory requirements.

We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 3. Data Sharing
sections.content:
We share data only when necessary:

• With infrastructure providers (Google Cloud, MongoDB Atlas, AWS) that process data on our behalf under strict contractual safeguards.
• With integrated services (WhatsApp Business API, Channex, Rentals United) to the extent required for their operation.
• With legal authorities when required by law or court order.

All sub-processors are bound by data-processing agreements compliant with GDPR and Moroccan data-protection law.

sections.title: 4. Data Hosting & Security
sections.content: Your data is hosted in France (Google Cloud europe-west9, Paris) and encrypted both in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest. We implement access controls, audit logging and regular security reviews to protect against unauthorised access, alteration or destruction.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
sections.content:
Our website uses:

• Strictly necessary cookies to enable core functionality.
• Performance cookies to analyse website usage (anonymised).
• Optional cookies for personalisation.

You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings at any time.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy or as required by law. Account data is retained for the duration of the subscription plus six (6) months. Guest data processed on behalf of users is retained according to the user's settings and applicable local regulations.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content:
Under GDPR and Moroccan law (Loi 09-08), you have the right to:

• Access the personal data we hold about you.
• Rectify inaccurate or incomplete data.
• Request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten).
• Restrict or object to certain processing.
• Data portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
• Withdraw consent for optional processing at any time.

To exercise these rights, contact us at support@sojori.com. We will respond within thirty (30) days.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this policy to reflect regulatory changes or service improvements. Material changes will be communicated via email or on our website at least thirty (30) days in advance.

items.a: Sojori is a PMS and a set of agents that work on WhatsApp for short-term rentals, concierge companies, riads and hotels. The agents reply to guests, coordinate the field team and prepare the decisions you approve. Sojori is built for Morocco.
Not necessarily. Sojori offers its own PMS, or works with yours: the agents and WhatsApp modules run on both. Dynamic pricing remains reserved for properties managed in the Sojori PMS.

items.q: What do the Sojori agents do?
items.a: Sojori offers one agent per role: Booking, Guest Service, Operations, Dynamic pricing, Assistant, Studio, Website, Sales, Prospecting, Marketing and Finance, plus calling agents under construction. For each one, you set whether it acts alone or waits for your approval.

items.q: How does WhatsApp check-in work, with the police registration form and the contract?
items.a: Sojori runs check-in on WhatsApp: each guest sends a photo of their ID, which is read automatically, signs the stay contract online and chooses their arrival time. Sojori prepares the police registration form for each guest and follows up automatically if check-in is not completed.

items.q: Is Sojori suited to concierge companies and hotels?
items.a: Yes. Sojori is built for concierge companies, owners of villas and apartments, riads, guesthouses and hotels, starting with Morocco. The “Room” scene shows a typical day for a concierge company with 50 properties and for a hotel with 30 or 100 rooms.
Sojori is billed per property, depending on the agents and modules you choose. An advisor sends you a quote tailored to your portfolio: no amount is shown on this site.

items.q: How is a Sojori offer built?
items.a: Sojori builds the offer with you in five choices: the foundation (the Sojori PMS or your own), the size of your portfolio, the agents and WhatsApp access, the website, and setup. Each option is activated property by property.

items.q: What do I receive after my request?
items.a: A Sojori advisor replies with a quote tailored to your portfolio, and offers you a demo on your own properties.

items.q: Can I keep my current PMS?
items.a: Yes. Sojori works with the Sojori PMS or with your own. With your PMS, the agents and WhatsApp modules remain available; dynamic pricing remains reserved for Sojori PMS properties.

items.q: Can I activate only some of the agents?
items.a: Yes. You choose the agents and modules you need, property by property, and add others later without redoing the setup.
